Inside a vast ice cavern overgrown with biomechanical tissue: the Engineer's ship (a long low survey shuttle with a teal-glass canopy bubble, sensor dishes and antennae, cyan diagnostic lines along its iron hull) tumbling down through the shattered cavern ceiling in sparks and falling ice, panels tearing loose, a moment before impact; below it a hive creature rears up on the cavern floor among glistening egg sacs, directly in its path.

jobs.camera: Fast tracking shot with impact shake following the shuttle as it hits, skewers the creature and rolls across the cavern floor
jobs.action: The shuttle hits the cavern floor hard, its snapped sensor dish spearing the rearing hive creature in a spray of ichor, then rolls across the ice scattering panels and bursting egg sacs before it stops on its side, sparks and teal screens flickering.
jobs.lastFrame: Wide cinematic establishing shot with no people, no figures and no faces anywhere: the ship is the only subject and stays fully in frame, dwarfed by the vastness around it; every organic form belongs to hulls, spires, ice and terrain, never a body. the wrecked shuttle on its side in an ice cavern overgrown with biomechanical tissue, panels scattered, a hive creature impaled on a snapped dish spraying ichor, sparks and flickering teal screens through the cracked canopy.
